# Spine InnovTech

> Intelligence for Connected Business — and Spine Workspace, where humans and AI work from shared business context.

Canonical Domain: https://spineinnovtech.com
Documentation Index: https://spineinnovtech.com/llms.txt

## Platform Architecture & Technical Documentation
- [Documentation Hub](https://spineinnovtech.com/docs): Technical documentation hub, architecture specifications, and API reference.
- [Platform Architecture](https://spineinnovtech.com/platform): Overview of the Spine platform, twin architecture, and contextual continuity layer.
- [Spine Fabric](https://spineinnovtech.com/platform/spine-fabric): Contextual continuity layer connecting source systems without data duplication.
- [How It Works](https://spineinnovtech.com/platform/how-it-works): Deterministic ingestion, entity resolution, and governance boundaries.
- [Infrastructure](https://spineinnovtech.com/platform/infrastructure): Multi-tenant isolation, edge routing, and cloud infrastructure.
- [Integrations Catalog](https://spineinnovtech.com/platform/integrations): 65+ connectors for CRM, ERP, support, code, and communications.
- [Developers](https://spineinnovtech.com/developers): MCP server integration, local development, and API access.
- [Security Architecture](https://spineinnovtech.com/security): Tenant isolation, encryption, access boundaries, and audit logging.
- [Governance Model](https://spineinnovtech.com/governance): Read-and-propose execution model with mandatory human approval.
- [Business Context](https://spineinnovtech.com/business-context): Carrying durable context and evidence across systems of record.
- [Spine Twin](https://spineinnovtech.com/twin): Context-aware assistant operating strictly within permitted business boundaries.
- [The Adaptive Workspace](https://spineinnovtech.com/adaptive-workspace): Role-based workbenches adapting to each function.
- [Approval Gates](https://spineinnovtech.com/product/approval-gate-twin): Governed actions requiring human sign-off before write-back.
- [Continuity](https://spineinnovtech.com/continuity): Multi-session conversational and task continuity without context loss.
- [Host-Connected Environment](https://spineinnovtech.com/host-connected-environment): Operating natively inside customer-managed environments.

## Role & Functional Solutions
- [Account Success](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/customer-success): Carry customer history from onboarding to growth.
- [Finance & Business Operations](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/finance): Revenue, risk, and operations from unified truth.
- [Sales](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/sales): Revenue continuity grounded in records and conversation context.
- [Marketing](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/marketing): Campaigns connected to verifiable business outcomes.
- [Content](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/content): Editorial production with the brief's full context.
- [Customer Support](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/customer-support): Ticket resolution with the full customer story in view.
- [Product & Engineering](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/product-engineering): Roadmaps and delivery linked to customer signals.
- [Founders & CXOs](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/founders): Goals, KPIs, decisions, and execution in one picture.
- [Human Resources](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/human-resources): People operations with the records and context for each decision.
- [Legal](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/legal): Contract reviews with evidence and authority.
- [Memory & Knowledge](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/memoryandknowledge): Organizational memory that compounds over time.
- [Individual / Personal](https://spineinnovtech.com/solutions/individual): Personal workspace with boundaries kept strictly separate.
